tasks.description: Add a 'Forgot password?' link on the login page that opens a form for users to request a password reset. The form should collect the user's account email.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user on the login page, when they click the 'Forgot password?' link, then a form to enter their email address is displayed.

tasks.description: Develop a function to generate single-use, time-limited reset tokens. These tokens should be unique and expire after a set time window.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when a token is generated, then the token is unique and has a limited lifetime.

tasks.description: On request, email a reset link containing the generated token to the user's registered email address. Ensure the link is properly formatted and includes the token.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when the reset email is sent, then the email contains a link with the reset token.

tasks.description: Create a form where users can enter and confirm a new password. The form should validate the reset token before accepting the new password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user follows the reset link, when they enter and confirm a new password, then the password is updated if the token is valid.

tasks.description: Upon successful reset, hash and store the new password using the existing password-hashing scheme. Ensure the password update is secure and follows best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when the new password is stored, then it is hashed using the existing password-hashing scheme.

tasks.description: After a successful password reset, invalidate the user's existing sessions to prevent account takeover. Ensure previously issued tokens can no longer be used.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when they attempt to use an existing session token, then the token is rejected.
